submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I tested the region near BiVO4 stoichiometry (Bi≈V), where the photoactive monoclinic BiVO4 phase at 2.4 eV is expected, and varied the Fe content. Index 30 (Bi 0.39, Fe 0.17, V 0.44; low Fe, slightly V-rich) gave 1.27e-6 A. That is about 2.4x index 22 and about 5x index 78, which is consistent with Fe hurting performance and a slight V excess helping.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.3e-7 A: low Fe but Bi-rich (Bi/V > 1), below index 30.
Measured 2.6e-7 A: high Fe (0.35) strongly lowers photocurrent.
